- Days 15–21 (First Campaign Launch): Launch newly produced creative assets and campaign architecture.
- Day 30 (First Monthly Review): Deliver structured executive performance deck answering what happened, why, and next quarter scaling plan.

knowledgeDocs.title: Google Ads Search Intent & Negative Keyword Curation Framework
knowledgeDocs.summary: Standard operating manual for eliminating wasted ad spend and maximizing search impression share.
knowledgeDocs.contentSnippet:
Search Intent Rules:
1. Match Type Discipline: Never launch broad match keywords without extensive negative keyword lists and proven conversion tracking history. Prefer Exact [keyword] and Phrase "keyword".
2. Negative Keyword Categories:
   - Employment & Career: "jobs", "salary", "internship", "hiring", "resume"
   - Information Seeking: "free", "how to make", "DIY", "course", "tutorial", "wikipedia"
   - Low-Intent Bargain: "cheap", "free download", "discount code", "craigslist", "reddit"
3. Weekly Search Query Scrub: Review search term reports every Monday and add irrelevant queries to shared agency master negative list.
